clues.text: This country’s Milford Sound in Fiordland National Park is one of the wettest inhabited places in the world.
This country is home to the only living sphenodon, and this country’s highest point, Aoraki, is located in its Southern Alps.
Smaller islands that are part of this nation include the Chatham Islands and Stewart Islands.
Visitors to this country can take a 630 foot “SkyJump” from the Sky Tower in this country’s most populous city, Auckland.
The Cook Strait separates the two main islands of this country, whose smaller main island contains the old capital of Auckland.
A phenomenon known as Tolkien tourism is credited with increasing tourism in this country, where the Lord of the Rings trilogy was filmed.
Cook Strait separates this country’s North and South islands.
The Maori people live on the North and South Islands in what nation with a capital at Wellington that sits over 1,000 miles off the coast of Australia?
Identify this country at the southwestern tip of Polynesia with capital at Wellington.
Name this island country east of Australia.
This country’s Mount Rapehu serves as the source of the Waikato River, which drains into Lake Taupo.
This nation’s largest lake is in the caldera of Mount Tauhara and is part of a Volcanic Zone that extends to the Bay of Plenty.
This country’s Antarctic claim is known as the Ross Dependency, which was the home of the World Park Base.
The Fox and Franz Joseph glaciers lie along this country’s Southern Alps.
Lake Taupo was formed as a caldera following a supervolcanic eruption in this country, and its city of Christchurch was rocked by multiple earthquakes in 2010.
This country’s Antipodes Islands are notable for lying near the opposite side of the earth from London, and its Canterbury Plains are located south of Christchurch.
Proposed designs for a replacement for this country’s flag feature a red Southern Cross next to a silver fern.
The highest point in this country, Aoraki, lies in its Southern Alps, and it is divided into two parts by the Cook Strait.
Its two parts are separated by the Cook Strait and are known as North and South Island.
Name this island nation, with a capital at Wellington and whose largest city is Auckland.
To the north of this nation’s Cape Regina lie the Three Kings Islands.
In this country, the Seddon Park stadium in Hamilton is the home ground of the Northern Districts domestic cricket team.

The “never shake a baby” campaign in this country started after the death of the Kahui twins, and a Guardian article referred to the “normalization” of child poverty this country’s “most shameful secret.”
The steepest street in the world, Baldwin Street, is located in this country’s city of Dunedin, which is the largest city in the Otago region.
This nation’s Canterbury Plains run parallel to where the Pacific Plate and the Indo-Australian Plate collide to form its longest mountain range, the Southern Alps.
This country claims Ross Dependency in Antarctica, and a major tourist destination in this country is Milford Sound.
It’s not in Europe, but this country is home to the Southern Alps.
This nation is also known as Aotearoa, its Māori name.
Name this Pacific dual-island country off the Australian coast whose capital is Wellington.
Name this island nation home to the cities of Christchurch, Auckland and Wellington.
